RL games: engine, physics, training and policy runtime

Read from each game repo: ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt, Packages/manifest.json, the .uproject, and training/pyproject.toml or requirements.txt.

What moved

  1. ENGINE Frontend is a real column again, not "Unity, except PoSlapUnreal" in the shared line. Eight games are Unity 6.6 (WebGL) and PoSlapUnreal is Unreal Engine 5.8. The "all but one" rule now applies to Sign-in only.
  2. NEW Physics: MuJoCo (PoBox 3.5 plugin; PoHillKing, PoOlympic, PoRace in the browser; PoSlapUnreal 3.10 via Unreal Robotics Lab) or Unity physics (the ML-Agents games).
  3. NEW RL training: Unity ML-Agents 4.1 (PoFootball, PoRumble), Unity ML-Agents (PoSoccer, PoSumo), MuJoCo Warp + rsl_rl PPO on PyTorch (PoHillKing), MuJoCo Warp + PPO (PoBox), MuJoCo Warp + PyTorch (PoOlympic, PoSlapUnreal), and MuJoCo Playground + Brax PPO on JAX (PoRace).
  4. NEW Policy runtime: Unity Inference Engine, ML-Agents inference (PoSumo), or Unreal NNE with ONNX Runtime (PoSlapUnreal).
  5. PLAY No Google Play links yet. Every game has an Android package id (com.punkoutersoftware.*), but none has a public Play Store page: all return 404, including the PoSumo link the docs site already carries.
